title: Text: DET Dave Littlefield ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I finally realized what your answer meant when I asked you about Mize’s changeup after he was shut down.
I asked him yesterday how his changeup was developing. It was a bad question considering he does not throw a changeup.
Do you have any background you could provide about when you told him he was shut down? (Where, Who was there, etc)
